explanation: The value is 0 at GO and D2 and fires only at D1. It is about 10 when the previous trial was a rare transition into S1 (the agent chose a2 but landed in S1) and that trial was rewarded; it is about 1 when that rare a2-to-S1 trial went unrewarded, occasionally around 5 after a rewarded common a1-to-S1 trial, and 0 after everything else.
